messages.subject: [Expm-developers] expm 0.98-3 uploaded to CRAN's incoming
messages.body_plain:
This a bug fix release  expm 0.98-3  for

logm( <sparse> )

which actually failed because of a Matrix infelicity (which is also
fixed, but only just on R-forge),
and the current expm code does no logger trigger the problematic 'Matrix' code.

Martin
